Name: Unlockable Bundles - Olden Days Interface Compatibility
Author: magicalamity
Description:
[size=4][b]Main Info:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]After seeing the magnificent work that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/249941241]HazelNuttAndFrog[/url] did with their new interface retexture Olden Days Interface I knew it would be going straight to my mods folder, they've included compatibility on their side for a few mods including Happy Home Designer (!!!) This is just a very rough slapped together UI recolour for the Unlockable Bundles mod using the same theme as Olden Days, if/when HazelNutt decides to do their own (superior) version I'll take this down but I thought I'd upload my quick edit for anyone else who hates seeing mismatched UI interfaces.
EDIT: Nexus isn't allowing me to add Olden Days or Unlockable Bundles in the requirement tabs please go download and endorse the original mods!![/color]

[size=4][b]Install Instructions:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Unzip the folder[/*]
[*]Copy the folder to where your Unlockable Bundles folder is[/*]
[*]When it says Write Into and Replace click "Yes"[/*]
[*]Done![/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53659]Olden Days Interface[/url], technically not needed but get it, it will change your life.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url], the main mod this replaces.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits and Thanks:[/b][/size]
Thank you to HazelNuttAndFrog for the gorgeous interface and for her open permissions! I am so so in love with her interface and eagerly await any future mods/retextures she does. 
Thanks to DeLiXx for the Unlockable Bundles mod of course.
